2. Wrapped the continuation of the book title ("Oder, 38. Predigten von dem jüngsten Gericht ... uc.") in its own <TITLE> element, since it is part of the advertised book's title and was left untagged apart from the unmatched closing tag.
3. The <VOLUME> tags around "38." and "4." denote numbers of sermons within the title, not volumes; they were kept but nested correctly inside the TITLE element so the markup is well-formed.
4. <YEAR>Septembris</YEAR> was changed to <DATE>Septembris</DATE>, as "Septembris" is a month, not a year.
5. Normalised the misencoded characters that corrupted the text (√ü → ß/ss, √ß → äu, √ºn → ün, √ßn → än etc.), e.g. "Bericht-Hauß", "Bräutigam", "hinauß", "jüngsten", "ünseligen", "länger", "biß", "Buß-Predigten", "versaumen".
Note: <PRIZE> tags were retained as in the source (price information)."}
